## Update reliability

- Show separate download and extraction progress for large updates, and display update errors instead of leaving the status stuck.
- Check Windows installation-folder permissions and show failures during the final file-copy stage.
- Wait for the app-owned Ollama server to stop before applying an update.

If an older version's updater is stuck, close the app and manually extract the Windows ZIP into a writable folder. Copy any portable `Jobs` folder beside the new executable; jobs stored under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EngineeringApp\uploads` remain in place.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.32...v0.1.33
